name: towles-tool
description: Chris Towles's personal Claude Code plugins: the map-vs-territory workflow commands, and a bridge to the towles-tool desktop app (MCP server + gh refresh hook).

plugins.name: tt
plugins.description: Commands for discovering your unknowns across the map-vs-territory workflow (trq212, 'The map is not the territory'). Before: /blindspot, /brainstorm, /interview, /references; plan/during: /plan (also keeps implementation notes while building); after: /pitch, /comprehend, /memories, /handoff; landing: /pr opens a PR, /prm opens and merges it. A mod offers each `! <command>` Claude hands you as a copy row above the prompt.

plugins.name: towles-tool-app
plugins.description: Bridges Claude Code to the towles-tool desktop app: its loopback-HTTP MCP server for board tasks, the Preview pane and calendar, plus a mod that shows this checkout's task, PR and next meeting in a band above the prompt, delivers notes you send the session from the app (read at the agent's next step), adds /park to file an idea as a backlog task and /next to suggest your next prompt, and a hook that nudges the app to refresh PR/issue data after a `gh pr`/`gh issue` mutation. Requires the app to be running.
